title: Common rules
description: Check that a value is present, or that it is an object or a boolean.

title: String rules
description: Compare and measure strings. Numbers are validated as strings.

title: Numeric rules
description: Check numbers and strings that look like numbers, and return them as numbers.

title: Special rules
description: Emails, URLs, dates and times, and comparison with another field.

title: Metarules
description: Describe nested objects, lists, conditions and alternatives with other rules.

title: List rules
description: Check the length of a list and that its items are unique.

title: Format rules
description: Identifiers, network addresses, encodings and other common string formats.

title: Checksum rules
description: Numbers with a check digit: Luhn, payment cards and IBANs.

title: Modifiers
description: Change the data. Modifiers never return errors.
